symbols.name: ResourceLeaseContext
symbols.summary: Retains a caller-owned resource while asynchronous work outlives its bounded caller wait.
symbols.remarks: This context grants no admission. It contains only disposable resource accounts; it never carries payloads, identities or HTTP objects. Dispose scopes in reverse creation order in the same asynchronous flow. Captures may extend a live resource after its original scope closes, provided another capture still owns it. A resource whose last reference was released cannot be resurrected.

symbols.name: Begin(IDisposable)
symbols.summary: Takes ownership of one existing resource account and establishes an ambient reference until this scope and all captures end.
symbols.remarks: Nested scopes retain their parent account transitively. Do not also dispose the supplied account independently.

parameters.description: An already admitted resource; the context becomes responsible for its exactly-once disposal. Null adds no scope.

returns.description: A scope which restores the previous ambient context and releases its own reference when disposed, or null for a null resource.

symbols.name: Capture()
symbols.summary: Retains the current live resource for already admitted work, without changing the current asynchronous flow.

returns.description: An independently disposable reference, or null when no ambient resource remains live.
